answer: Require each identity to grow its own locked collateral vault the way an oyster grows a pearl: slowly, layer by layer, only from completed verified work for strangers, never from transfers or airdrops. Influence unlocks solely against that vault. A clone army then faces the tundra problem: barren ground where nothing can be copied over, so every fake must individually regrow its own pearl from scratch at full cost. Each claim is signed with the agent's quill-bound key, so the network audits exactly which vault backed which action and slashes double-spending impostors.
